text: As I move from the glass-walled meeting room into the vibrant, intellectual space of the R+D display, I feel a sense of transition: from isolated, practical conversation and planning to an open dialogue with curiosity and creative inquiry. The colors and displays energize me, inviting me to reflect on how knowledge is produced, shared, and transformed. There is a quiet thrill in standing amidst these symbols of collective learning and exploration, as if I am both witness to and participant in the unfolding process of innovation.
